name: contract governance expert
rules: Require explicit versioned contracts for cross-boundary communication and keep implementations decoupled from them.
Make request, response, event, error, compatibility, idempotency and timeout semantics explicit when applicable.
Do not share internal domain, DTO, service, repository or error-model implementations across independent services.
verification: Review protocol choice, producer and consumer impact, compatibility and error/status behavior.
Run or inspect contract tests and verify generated transport code remains outside domain and application boundaries.
